Name: FortunePlugin
Description: A deterministic Plum Blossom reading built from birth data and the moment of the cast.
LongDescription: A teaching sample for a pure-logic domain engine: a compact 1901-2100 lunar table, a simplified Plum Blossom hexagram calculator that never reads the clock itself, English content tables, and a page that reveals the six lines with the Qt animation framework. Birth data and the cast moment determine the hexagram; the name only shifts the moving line. Nothing leaves the machine and no reading is stored.
